reuse.why: Edits the existing inline rule in computeSchedulePreviewTransactions but keeps the hand-written 0.075 tolerance instead of calling the existing getApproxNumberThreshold in shared/rules.ts.

duplication.why: Adds no new copies; the tolerance arithmetic it touches remains a pre-existing duplicate of getApproxNumberThreshold.

placement.why: The change stays where the preview amount rule already lives (shared/schedules.ts), though the rule is buried in a nested ternary rather than a named helper next to getScheduledAmount.

scope.why: Only the amount expression, its comment and the matching tests change.

maintainability.why: Math.min on the range is clear, but the 'lowest allowed value' rule remains an anonymous nested ternary with an inline tolerance constant, so the next rule change must again edit this expression.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Inline 0.075 tolerance in computeSchedulePreviewTransactions predates the change; the diff keeps rather than introduces the bypass of getApproxNumberThreshold.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic introduced; the edit modifies the single existing expression.
